predicted_signals.evidence: Initiative 'Victory in the Living Room' organized by bereaved families and soldiers will host hundreds of fighters and bereaved families in Israeli homes on Memorial Day eve for remembrance and valor meetings sharing stories of battles and Israeli spirit.

Ziv Medical Center in Safed gradually returning hospital departments and outpatient clinics to original above-ground locations after months of operating from underground fortified complexes; coordinated with security authorities and Health Ministry
Ziv Medical Center director Professor Salman Zarqa stated: 'We work with responsibility and caution, maintaining full readiness to return to fortification at any moment if necessary'

Research on Gaza envelope residents: 71% reported deterioration in general health; 40% taking or considering medication to cope; 58% showing hypervigilance; suffering from sleep disorders, chronic fatigue, and abdominal pain from chronic stress.
מגישת ערוץ 14 נוי בר: 'ילדתי תחת טילים, ראיתי כוכבים מהכאב'
בעת הלידה התרחשה מתקפת טילים; הובלה לחדר לידה ממוגן בשל מתקפה שהתרחשה באותן דקות
13-year-old student in Be'er Ya'akov targeted by coordinated cyberbullying campaign with fake obituary notice and TikTok page designed to intensify social boycott

Business owner in Galilee: 'There's no work, no income, but expenses continue as usual. Rent, employees, suppliers. It's an impossible situation... Couriers don't enter the area. There are orders that haven't been collected in weeks. Drivers are in reserves, there's no continuity of work—everything is broken.'

Business owner describes shelter inadequacy: 'There's not enough protection. In one alert dozens of people are crammed into one shelter, and there's no room for everyone. People are afraid to come, and workers are afraid to work in such conditions.'

Village of Sha-Nur in northern Samaria reconnected to national electricity grid; two electricity company workers who disconnected power 20 years ago performed the reconnection, symbolizing restoration of services
Armed civilian at Doron Valley Farm prevented stabbing attack by drawing personal firearm and shooting terrorist who attempted to stab Israeli civilians

Authorities and regional councils in the northern border area issued immediate warnings to residents to stay close to protected spaces due to concrete indications of imminent missile fire from Lebanon
Hezbollah fired dozens of rockets, sending tens of thousands of Israelis to bomb shelters
Hezbollah rocket barrage wounding one Israeli
Reauvén Barsheshet describes injury from service: 'The pain from the injury during service was also psychological.' He reports loss of sensation, inability to move his hand, and had to stop serving.
Residents and shoppers in Netivot experienced panic when tens of thousands of bees invaded the commercial center; people screamed and fled to enclosed spaces
Business owners in the commercial center closed shop doors and windows in response to the bee swarm
גבר בן 61 נפצע באורח קל מרסיסים בגפיים בטמרה בעקבות מטח שיגורי רקטות מלבנון
Civil air traffic largely curtailed following October 7 attack; many foreign carriers repeatedly suspended or canceled Tel Aviv routes
State Comptroller found no procedure in place to prioritize return of Israeli passengers abroad during war; soldiers and reservists struggled with air travel options and bore high financial burdens

Bank of Israel extended the enrollment window for war-affected households and businesses support framework by one additional month, allowing payment deferrals, mortgage extensions, and increased credit lines.
ראשי רשויות בצפון פרסמו הודעות לתושביהן כי ישנה התראה על מטחי ירי של חיזבאללה בטווח הזמן הקרוב
עמית סופר, ראש המועצה האזורית מרום הגליל: 'תושבי קו העימות רוצים ביטחון אמיתי ולא שקט תעשייתי... אנחנו מבקשים שממשלת ישראל תמשיך להכות בחיזבאללה עד לפירוקו מנשקו'

Yehali Ifirgan, 16-year-old student in Shlomi near Lebanon border: 'We're not prepared for the exam at all. If we were living in Ramat HaSharon or Tel Aviv and Hezbollah was shooting there, it would look completely different.'
שא-נור חוברה מחדש לרשת החשמל; עובדי חברת החשמל שהוריד את השאלטר בעת הגירוש הדליקו אותו מחדש
Nature and Parks Authority issued sharp warning to public planning to hike in Dead Sea, Negev, or Arava areas due to risk of flash floods on Friday; absolute prohibition on entering wadi channels

Of 11,000 Kiryat Shmona residents who requested a four-night respite break from shelters, more than half were left behind due to budget shortage. Only 4,600 places allocated; 8,500 residents from border communities went in first rotation; over 6,000 requests from the city were rejected.
המועצה האזורית גוש עציון חציתה רף של 30,000 תושבים; בשנה האחרונה הצטרפו 931 תושבים חדשים בקצב גידול של כ-3.6%

Police completed preparations for state cup semifinal match at Teddy Stadium in Jerusalem with 5,000 capacity limit per Home Front Command guidelines; deployed officers, security personnel, and traffic management

Independence Day central stages cancelled in most local authorities due to security situation and Home Front Command restrictions on mass gatherings, leaving thousands of artists, technicians, and production staff facing contract cancellations.

Local authorities agreed to book cancelled Independence Day artists for alternative events throughout the year (Jerusalem Day, summer events, holidays) to prevent economic harm to artists and production crews.

Ministry of Construction and Housing delayed opening of 'Apartment at Discount' lottery registration to advance emergency order allocating half of apartments to reserve duty soldiers, adding 1,139 apartments to soldier allocation in upcoming lottery
אביחי שטרן, ראש עיריית קריית שמונה: "אנשים נמצאים יותר מ-40 ימים מתחת לאדמה... בזמן שפה אנחנו לא צופים מתי זה יגיע אלינו"
שטרן: "אנחנו גדלנו ככה, אני הייתי מאותם ילדים שראיינו במקלטים, ולנו הבטיחו שהילדים שלנו לא יהיו במקלטים"

Jerusalem Mayor Moshe Lion announced Independence Day celebrations will proceed as planned, following consultations and noting no Home Front Command restrictions in Jerusalem preventing public gatherings.
Mayor Lion: 'This is definitely a statement and a symbol. We stand in solidarity with residents of the north and south... Jerusalem, the capital of Israel, needs to celebrate Independence Day.'
פגיעה ישירה בנהריה מרקטה שחצתה מלבנון; פצועה אחת בת 60 נפגעה באורח קל עם פציעות הדף ורסיסי זכוכית
ד"ר רפאל סטרוגו, סמנכ"ל רפואה ומד"א: 'גל החום והטמפרטורות הגבוהות מחייבות זהירות ועירנות ציבורית. אני ממליץ להרבות בשתייה ולא לשהות זמן ממושך תחת שמש ישירה'
Magen 48 conducted near-weekly training sessions across the country, training 67 communities and over 1,500 civilian first responders—local volunteers serving as first line of defense.
Ari Briggs: 'On October 7th, we learned that it's not enough to wait for help to arrive. Communities must be able to hold the line until it does.'
צה"ל עדכן מדיניות התגוננות החל מ-13 באפריל בשעה 21:00 עד 14 באפריל בשעה 20:00, עם הנחיות ספציפיות לאזורים שונים
פורסמו עדכונים משמעותיים בהנחיות ההתגוננות לאזרחים. ההנחיות החדשות נכנסו לתוקף החל מהשעה 21:00 (13 באפריל 2026)

Yoel Provisor: 'We try to help Holocaust survivors with whatever's needed.' Institute provides food packages twice monthly, therapeutic staff conduct house visits, phone calls, group meetings, help with home repairs.
Provisor: 'For many survivors, the war demanded more than they could physically manage.'

Brother Chaykel: 'I want to thank the dear volunteers of ZAKA and all of Israel who are mobilizing wholeheartedly to try to find my brother. It is not obvious to see this dedication in the middle of the night.'
ZAKA volunteers working at search site in Netanya during night hours to locate missing persons
צה"ל עדכן מדיניות התגוננות עם הנחיות ספציפיות לפעילות חינוכית בתוך מרחב מוגן תקני והגבלת התקהלויות

Government approved extension of special emergency status in rear until April 28, citing ongoing fire, uncertainty regarding ceasefire with Iran, and security assessment that fire expected to continue against civilian population
שורדי שואה שביטלה טיסתם קיבלו נרות נשמה בביתם כדי לשמור על המשכיות הזיכרון בצל המלחמה
ההתאחדות לכדורגל הודיעה על עצירה מיידית של מכירת הכרטיסים למשחק חצי גמר גביע המדינה בעקבות החמרת הנחיות פיקוד העורף
Homeowner in Kiryat Shmona extinguished a drone carrying explosives with a water hose after it struck without being detected or triggering alert
ראש עיריית ירושלים החליט לקיים חגיגות יום העצמאות כסדרם: "זה נורא קל לבטל אירועים, אבל מדברים כאן גם על מקור פרנסה לאמנים"
Survey: When asked about Iran, 39% said Israel should resume attacks, 41% said respect ceasefire, 19% unsure. Support for Netanyahu declined to 34% from 40% at war outset.
עמותת ער"ן: התקבלו יותר מ-11,600 פניות משורדי שואה מאז תחילת מלחמת חרבות ברזל; כ-50 שורדים נפגעו בבתיהם; 36% זקוקים לסיוע ברכישת מזון
27% משורדי השואה נאלצו לוותר על מזון עקב מצוקה כלכלית; יותר מ-70 אלף שורדים (65%) חיים לבדם
רבים משורדי השואה מתמודדים עם פחד מתמשך בשל היעדר מיגון מתאים בזמן אזעקות

Sociologist Prof. Noa Levit: 'This is an experience of nothing, of emptiness. They are simply living their lives in a kind of indifference.' Experts warn of surrender, loss of stability, and young people adopting a sense of 'lost generation'

Expert commentary: 'We talk about the resilience of Israeli society, but I see indifference and numbness of senses.' Ongoing emergency eroding parental stability, deepening feelings of failure and guilt, changing how children grow up
Mayor Stern: 'We grew up like this - I was one of those children interviewed in shelters, and we were promised that our children would not be in shelters.'

Government decision to extend special emergency status in rear until April 28, enabling Home Front Command to continue exercising broad powers including orders to remain in protected spaces, precautionary measures, restrictions on education, and directives to aid organizations
משרד הבריאות: מספר הנפגעים שפונו לבתי החולים מתחילת מבצע 'שאגת הארי' עומד על 7,693 בני אדם
104 נפגעים מוסיפים להיות מאושפזים במרכזים הרפואיים ברחבי הארץ, מתוכם שניים במצב אנוש ו-13 במצב קשה

Jerusalem Municipality decided Independence Day events will proceed as scheduled, subject to Home Front Command guidelines. Mayor Moshe Leon stated: 'Independence celebrations in Jerusalem are not just joy, but also responsibility for the livelihood of thousands of families, artists and suppliers—and responsibility to continue life, even in a complex period'
Isracard ו-JFNA הרחיבו כ-135 מיליון שקל בהלוואות מסובסדות לכ-1,500 עסקים בישראל מאז תחילת השותפות בתחילת 2025
הקרן עזרה לשמר כ-15,000 מקומות עבודה ותמוך בעשרות אלפי ישראלים בכ-100 ערים וקהילות

Home Front Command approved easing of guidelines in the Haifa Bay area, allowing educational activities in locations where protected spaces can be reached during alert time, and increasing gathering limits to 100 people outdoors and 400 indoors.

Despite Home Front Command approval, many municipal leaders in the north chose to impose stricter guidelines themselves. Cities including Acre, Nahariya, and Hadera decided not to open schools for in-person learning in the coming days.

Ayyel Shmueli, head of Kfar Vradim council: 'Despite reports of progress in ceasefire talks, the fighting on the ground continues at high intensity. The community is still exposed to heavy fire and Hezbollah aircraft movement at high frequency, and I estimate the organization will increase the pace of attacks toward the Galilee precisely in an attempt to influence the ceasefire negotiations.'
Jerusalem Municipality announces that the 15th Winner Jerusalem International Marathon will take place as planned on Friday, April 17, 2026, with approximately 40,000 participants expected.

Jerusalem Mayor Moshe Leon: 'The marathon marks a return to sports and leisure routine. It reflects the mental resilience of the Israeli public and the positive impact of sports activity at this time, and the ability to return to routine even after a complex security period.'

Toto CEO Meir Bardogo: 'This year, the 15th Winner Jerusalem Marathon is a clear first sign for the country returning to routine, and the return of leisure and sports life to a public that showed extraordinary courage in recent weeks.'

According to the Recovery Administration, approximately 93% of residents have returned to live in the Gaza envelope. Including the five communities that have not yet returned, return rates stand at approximately 89%.
The population in the Gaza envelope region has grown from approximately 62,000 before the war to approximately 65,000 today, primarily due to the growth of the city of Sderot.

Ayyel Shmueli, head of Kfar Vradim council: 'We are exposed to heavy fire and enemy aircraft movement at high frequency from Hezbollah. The organization may increase the pace of attacks toward the Galilee precisely on the backdrop of ceasefire talks.'
Ayyel Shmueli: 'I call on residents to continue to adhere to Home Front Command guidelines. They save lives.'

Extensive search operations launched along the shoreline and in the sea using boats, sonar systems, drones, and divers from the Fire and Rescue Unit, with volunteer divers from Zaka also participating in intensive underwater searches.

The organization 'Beterem' issued warnings and guidance to parents about safe swimming practices and the importance of parental guidance for teenagers regarding water safety during the upcoming beach season.

Alon Lee-Green of Standing Together: 'We struggled with the police to hold our protest, and week by week we grew. We defeated the Ben-Gvir police.' He stated: 'All these fronts - in Iran, in Lebanon, the West Bank, Gaza - are being waged at once as an eternal war, one that puts us in a constant state of emergency.'
Alon Lee-Green: 'Instead of sending our children to kill and get killed, we can have peace. There is another way!'

Approximately 40 rockets launched from Lebanon toward northern Israel on Saturday, triggering repeated air raid sirens across the Galilee and border communities; a building was damaged in Shlomi with no immediate reports of injuries.
Two soldiers from the Paratroopers Brigade moderately wounded during close-range encounter with Hezbollah terrorists in southern Lebanon; soldiers evacuated to hospital and families notified.
Alon-Lee Green: 'Instead of sending our children to kill and be killed, we can have peace. Only peace will bring security.'
Anti-war and anti-government protest held in Tel Aviv's Habima Square for the sixth consecutive week, with organizers calling to protest 'against the government of abandonment and the eternal war.'

Research by Prof. Allis Warburkel, head of the Bezalel School of Architecture, finds that privatization of shelter in homes eliminates shared community experience and prevents important discourse during emergencies.
